name: @kickside/simplefin-ui
title: SimpleFIN Connect
description: Provider-owned setup form for a SimpleFIN Bridge connection.

wippy.description: Setup form the Connections page mounts for the SimpleFIN provider. Pass provider-id, and component-id when rotating the credential of an existing connection. The user pastes a SimpleFIN setup token; the component creates the connection through the authenticated Wippy proxy, the server claims the token, and the discovered accounts are shown before connection-saved fires.

provider-id.description: Provider identifier the Connections page selected.

component-id.description: Existing connection component identifier when rotating its credential; empty while creating.

connection-saved.description: { success, component_id?, error? } once the connection is created or rotated.
